businesses.business: nonperforming loan purchasing and debt collection

offering_description.value: Purchases portfolios of defaulted consumer receivables, mainly from banks, credit card issuers and other lenders, at a discount. It then collects on them through call centers, legal channels and digital outreach, and also provides some fee-based collection services.

primary_products.value: portfolios of nonperforming consumer loans; defaulted credit card receivables; defaulted auto and personal loan receivables

primary_services.value: debt collection; accounts receivable recovery; bankruptcy claims servicing

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit card issuers and other lenders selling defaulted receivables; B2C: consumers with defaulted debts who repay the company

end_markets.value: consumer lending; banking; credit cards; auto finance

revenue_model.value: other: collections on purchased nonperforming loan portfolios; service fees: fees for collecting on behalf of clients

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: buys defaulted receivables from lenders and recovers payments from consumers; service provider: third-party collection and recovery services for creditors

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe (including UK, Germany, Spain, Italy), Latin America and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: purchased nonperforming loan portfolios and fee-based collection and recovery services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: portfolio purchases negotiated directly with banks and lenders, plus bidding through brokers; own locations: company call centers and collection operations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: debt collection licensing and conduct rules: FDCPA, CFPB Regulation F, state licensing, and foreign regulators
